say:3:1320801002:1.text: I'm right here! You don't need to yell in my ear. Can't you just say what you want to say?
say:3:1320801002:1.source_cn: 我在这里！不要一遍遍叫我名字，你就不能把想说的先说出来吗？

say:4:1320801003:1.text: This is the official procedure. I need to make sure you're listening to me first. Should we check the other ice mining locations?
say:4:1320801003:1.source_cn: 这是流程！我必须先确保你在听我讲话！我们要不要再去确认...

say:5:1320801004:1.text: No, we cannot leave the area if an accident occurs. That's also a part of the official procedure.
say:5:1320801004:1.source_cn: 不，遇到意外不能擅离工作区，这是规定！

choice_prompt:6:1320801004.text: No, we cannot leave the area if an accident occurs. That's also a part of the official procedure.
choice_prompt:6:1320801004.source_cn: 不，遇到意外不能擅离工作区，这是规定！

say:8:1320801007:1.text: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.
say:8:1320801007:1.source_cn: 我们被指派来挖冰块制作冰雕，但指定区域的坚冰已经被采过了。
say:8:1320801007:1.male: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.
say:8:1320801007:1.female: We were assigned here to dig for ice for sculpture-making, but the ice here has already been mined.

say:9:1320801008:1.text: You didn't tell them the worst part. The ice sculpture is already finished! I was so looking forward to relaxing and sipping some spiced goat milk after our delivery, but now everything's gone topsy-turvy!
say:9:1320801008:1.source_cn: 你没说清楚最糟糕的，那就是冰雕已经完成了！我还等着交付...

say:11:1320801009:1.text: Ice sculpture... Do you mean the ice sculpture used for the ceremony?
say:11:1320801009:1.source_cn: 冰雕……你们是说庆典上最后要用的冰雕？

say:12:1320801010:1.text: Which other one is there? We had improved our production process, optimized our procedures, and were all set to outdo our past work, but by the time we got there, the ice sculpture was already done!
say:12:1320801010:1.source_cn: 不然还有哪个？我们好不容易改进了制作工艺，优化流程，准...

say:13:1320801011:1.text: Wait... isn't that a good thing? Your job's done, so you don't need to worry about anything.
say:13:1320801011:1.source_cn: 呃……这不是好事吗？你们的工作已经完成，不用再赶工了。

say:17:1320801014:1.text: This is a huge slip-up! Think about it! Something that wasn't supposed to be done is now done. We have to figure out which part of the process went wrong, or else more mistakes may be compounded later.
say:17:1320801014:1.source_cn: 本来没有做完的东西，现在却做完了，这是难以忍受的巨大纰...

say:18:1320801015:1.text: Our construction records are never wrong, and we don't have a written record of a completed ice sculpture. People's memories are unreliable, so we must trust the paperwork.
say:18:1320801015:1.source_cn: 施工记录是不可能出错的，我们没有完成雕像的书面记录，记...

say:20:1320801017:1.text: Ah, I'll show you. Tory, take out the records!
say:20:1320801017:1.source_cn: 唉，给你们看看记录吧，托瑞，把东西拿出来！

say:22:1320801018:1.text: The records should be in my backpack. Folded thrice and wrapped in cowhide.
say:22:1320801018:1.source_cn: 记录在背包里，折了三叠，用牛皮纸包着。

say:23:1320801019:1.text: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?
say:23:1320801019:1.source_cn: 我的手不能离开矿镐，也不方便啊！这位魔法师朋友，你自己...
say:23:1320801019:1.male: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?
say:23:1320801019:1.female: I can't take my hand off my pick! Gotta keep working! How about you take it out yourself and take a look, my mage friend?

say:25:1320801006:1.text: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.
say:25:1320801006:1.source_cn: 哈，我喜欢这玩笑！不过我们遇到的更离谱！
say:25:1320801006:1.male: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.
say:25:1320801006:1.female: Ha! That's funny! No, it's worse than that.

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你们不会把矿洞搞塌了吧
